gloss: meeting up; rendezvous; appointment to meet

definitions.gloss: meeting up; rendezvous; appointment to meet
definitions.explanation: An arranged meeting at a specific time and place. Often used for casual meet-ups with friends or dates.

examples.japanese: {駅前|えきまえ}で{待|ま}ち{合|あ}わせしよう。
examples.english: Let's meet up in front of the station.

examples.japanese: {待|ま}ち{合|あ}わせの{時間|じかん}に{遅|おく}れてしまった。
examples.english: I was late for our meeting time.

examples.japanese: {待|ま}ち{合|あ}わせ{場所|ばしょ}が{分|わ}からなくて{迷|まよ}った。
examples.english: I got lost because I didn't know the meeting place.

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
{待|ま}ち (waiting, from {待|ま}つ) + {合|あ}わせ (combining, from {合|あ}わせる)
Literally: "waiting and meeting together"

USAGE:
{待|ま}ち{合|あ}わせ is commonly used for arranging to meet someone. It can be used as both a noun and with する as a verb.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{待|ま}ち{合|あ}わせをする - to arrange to meet
・{待|ま}ち{合|あ}わせする - to meet up (する verb)
・{待|ま}ち{合|あ}わせ{場所|ばしょ} - meeting place
・{待|ま}ち{合|あ}わせ{時間|じかん} - meeting time

RELATED WORDS:
・{待合室|まちあいしつ} - waiting room
・{集合|しゅうごう} - gathering, assembly (more formal)
・{約束|やくそく} - appointment, promise

REGISTER:
Neutral. Very common in everyday conversation.
